connector.name: Pagerduty MCP
connector.registryDescription: PagerDuty's official MCP server which provides tools to interact with your PagerDuty account.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package pagerduty-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the pagerduty account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PAGERDUTY_USER_API_KEY
env.description: PagerDuty User API Token - obtain from User Settings > API Access in your PagerDuty account

env.name: PAGERDUTY_API_HOST
env.description: PagerDuty API host URL (default: https://api.pagerduty.com, EU: https://api.eu.pagerduty.com)
